## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- Quality gate first attempt — evaluator misconfiguration (shared DB with live workers); resolved by a dedicated gate DB, see Quality gates.
- E2E-UPLOAD-01 uses `curl -T` rather than `--data-binary` (curl 7.81 limitation); flagged `*`.
- UI "drop" items use a synthetic drop event with a real File; flagged `*`.
- RSS sampling had low resolution (9 samples) because each `docker exec` sample takes ~0.7 s; the 33 MB delta leaves ample margin below 100 MB.
- Playwright and `libasound.so.2` were borrowed from outside the project (sibling project node_modules; Ubuntu deb extracted to the run tmpdir). Nothing in the project was modified.
- Tear-down: stack restored to its default configuration (api/worker on DB `chatledger`); both eval DBs dropped; tmpdir removed. Screenshots kept in `eval-screenshots-2026-10-02T12-43-42Z/`.
